outcome: Deliver persistent herd identities, both directions of herd/zone navigation, separate Diamond potential and Great One counts, and female Diamond-capability symbols without losing the integrated event-location or saved-game workflows.

previousCheckpoint.note: Retains the earlier saved-game/screenshot checkpoint chain and separately authorized account/Neon work. Event-location source was subsequently integrated; its newer files were preserved in this release.

ownerAcceptance.sequence: Finish and obtain acceptance of the entire agreed Phase 1, then remediate SI. Truthful claims and design quality apply now.

reference.generation: tools/build-herd-reference.mjs runs before native/browser/portable gates using the hash-verified pinned public input. The generated file is included in the package, not a synthetic fixture.
reference.authority: Community-extracted reference, not verification against every installed game patch.

native.scope: Complete repository with production catalogs and pinned generated herd metadata; same suite passed again during public verification, not additional independent cases.

browser.scope: Actual app, binary decoder, SQLite, canonical FieldMap, signed phone relay and Chromium, with disposable synthetic saves/journal observations and generated test media; not owner files.

completedVerified: Recovered the preserved herd candidate and applied only its 27-file delta to newer integrated location source b6629efd. All initial herd file blobs matched the tested candidate; newer hunt-locations.css and verify-hunt-locations.mjs remained unchanged. No synthetic workspace statistics dictionary or package settings were published.

Persistent readable herd labels survive database restart, record/member reordering and unambiguous continuity. Ambiguous matches and reset/restore boundaries receive new identities rather than silently reassigning old IDs. These are companion-tracked identities, not guaranteed native permanent herd IDs.

Herds expose assigned feeding/drinking/resting zones, schedules, coordinates, map views and retained assignment history. Zone filters identify all linked herds, including shared zones. Existing location history distinguishes shot, death and pickup observations, supports older records beyond the normal recent window, and retains attribution snapshots in deliberate exports.

Population Diamond potential, explicit saved Great Ones and additional unconfirmed candidates are separate; Great Ones are not counted twice as Diamonds. Career trophy totals remain distinct. The female symbol appears beside eligible species using sex-specific reference ranges; unknown eligibility remains unmarked.

Strict read-only PC/signed-phone herd queries, bounded pagination, no caller-controlled profile/path, spoiler revocation, stale-source behavior and private-field stripping passed. Actual SQLite restart preserved IDs and source save bytes remained unchanged.

The original 796a0286 candidate passed native/herd tests but failed the unchanged phone test: first harvest bottom 802 exceeded dock 770. It never deployed. The fix explicitly places herd details after recent grind results and prevents generic toolbar SVG rules shrinking maps. The original phone assertion stayed unchanged; the herd verifier gained actual grind-shell measurements at 1440, 390 and 320 pixels.

Final 5dfdb99c passed all 759 native tests and all eight local and eight live HTTPS browser workflows. Both source-identical Windows builds produced the same 78-file archive hash. Normal host PR279/280 and one same-source public-verification deploy used the existing paid service without changing unrelated product settings. App PR9 merged only into the working branch with no content difference from the tested runtime.
changedUnverified: Owner Windows installation and physical phone were not accessed or updated. Open the current complete PC package while preserving the companion data directory and existing working pairing, then reload the phone. This is not an automatic installed update.

Herd assignments/schedules do not establish real-time visits or current animal positions. Population Diamonds are stored-score potential, not awarded medals. Exact automatic shot/death/pickup capture and validated animal survival/event identity remain open.

Tests used synthetic player data and browser profiles. Personal-save compatibility, physical camera/gallery/OS share sheet and complete player/design acceptance remain open. Actual layouts were measured by browser tests; no new independent manual review of full-app screenshots is claimed.

Remaining inventory/loadout, detailed mission/build/unlock, lodge/companion mappings, real accounts/recovery, profiles/publication/community and broader game support remain in Phase 1. Honest Unknown labels do not complete these requirements. Separate account-provider/database work was preserved, not completed or reprovisioned.

Private phone copies are not full offline mode, a full-save cloud backup or new-device account recovery. The legacy static reference preview is a separate surface; it was not republished by this release. SI remediation has not begun.
